method: Fixed ceiling rose; crown and chain pendulum; three separately hinged source crystals; five visible source flame regions. Premultiplied-alpha source-art rig.

actions.idle: Small suspended swing, phase-lagged crystals and flame flicker.
actions.attack: Anticipatory draw-back, brighter candles, broad announcing swing with three distinct crystal responses, then recovery.
actions.hurt: Short crown jerk, reactive crystal shudder and a brief flame dip, then recovery.
actions.defeat: Candles go out sequentially; crystal light dims and the assembly settles into a still unlit ornament.

orientation.method: Crown rests with a leftward hanging bias, all source flames lean left; attack anticipates right then swings left, hurt recoils right, and defeat settles into the left-biased inactive pose. No mirroring of fixture or crystals.

review_limits: All decoded packing/timing checks passed and chronological poses inspected. Full-speed intended-size visual approval and game integration remain unverified.
